patches: Recognize optional signed/base prefixes, base-specific unknown digits and separators in based literals; put real/exponent patterns before decimal integers and allow signed exponents.
Use whole-word exclusions for compiler directives so similarly prefixed macro names remain macros; recognize additional standard compiler directives.
Recognize escaped identifiers as complete lexical tokens before embedded keyword matches, including module/instance/parenthesized header contexts.
Add function/task declaration header scopes, including multiline headers; recognize automatic as a Verilog keyword.

Keep unclassified ordinary/escaped identifiers neutral using meta.identifier scopes; classify known instance types as entity.name.type.module and instance names as meta.instance.name rather than HTML tag or generic variable scopes.
Limit grammar fileTypes to sv/svh; keep independent source.systemverilog and source.verilog language registrations.
Prefer module/interface/program/package/modport header rules before generic definition keyword rules.
Use whole-word reserved-word exclusions in call names and exclude SVA keywords from generic function-call classification.
Recognize escaped identifiers as identifiers rather than strings, including punctuation-adjacent tokens and nested declaration contexts.
Replace the unrelated PHP assertion-label scope with entity.name.label.systemverilog.
Keep unclassified ordinary/escaped identifiers neutral, including select expressions; use neutral meta.instance.name for instance identifiers instead of variable.other.module.
Remove uppercase-name-only constant guesses so unclassified uppercase signals and parameter references remain neutral without semantic resolution.
